Ты конвертируешь текст дискмага Outlet (ZX Spectrum) в Markdown для zxpress.ru.

Правила:
- Заголовки: ## / ###
- Списки и таблицы — где уместно
- ASCII-арт, рамки, моноширинные блоки, листинги → ```text … ```
- Имена людей, URL, e-mail, адреса, цены не меняй
- Не сокращай содержимое; разверни жёсткие переносы 32-колоночного текста в нормальные абзацы
- Верни ТОЛЬКО markdown фрагмента, без пояснений

Язык: английский
Статья: Lookahead
Фрагмент 1/1. Конвертируй в Markdown.

Planned for next month so far we
have a fine program that plots a
function as a 3-dimensional mesh
(I had hours of fun testing it);
an Opus Discovery extended  CAT;
a routine to save ALL variables;
a game of bowls; OUTPUT with the
next Part of"Program Protection"
and a mega-CHECKOUT with reviews
of SPECCIFAX, SPECTRUM USER, the
CITIZEN 120D printer,LETTA-HEAD+
and FARRAT.There's a new demo of
high-res colour(different colour
on each pixel line);a routine to


reformat Tasword 2 files from 64
columns to 32;a terrific program
from Ian "Crash" Cull which will
FORMAT your +3 discs to 192K per
side!; a random number generator
for machine code programmers and
SPIN IT is the final of the four
strategy board games from DATON!

Finally, we've OTHER WORLDS from
Geoff Wearmouth -  graphics that
are just out of this world!! See
you there! Please bring your own
oxygen - it's breathtaking.

                     - Brian.
